paragraph: In June 2024 the interbank services company EMIS said its [Cidadão Digital project had trained over 500,000 young people](<https://www.angop.ao/noticias/tecnologia/programa-cidadao-digital-investe-mais-de-400-milhoes-de-kwanzas/>). By December 2024 it [reported over 600,000 people reached since 2022](<https://www.menosfios.com/projeto-cidadao-digital-alcancou-mais-de-600-mil-pessoas-revela-emis/>). No government body is named for these counts. In the last twelve months, a presidential order of August 2026 [gave US$5 million to a national programme in basic digital skills](<https://pti.ao/formacao-de-agentes-locais-o-passo-seguinte-ao-investimento-em-infra-estrutura-digital/>). In October 2026 President João Lourenço [authorised US$20 million for digital-skills centres](<https://poligrafoafrica.com/fact-check/joao-lourenco-autoriza-despesa-de-20-milhoes-usd-para-capacitacao-digital-em-angola/>). No count of people trained by a government programme has been found. Establishing would need a government digital-skills programme for the public, in service in more than one location, that has trained a stated number of people.

On 25 September 2025 the digital economy ministry [launched phase III of the AGCCI coding camps](<https://abpinfo.bi/2025/09/30/la-promotion-des-competences-numeriques-des-jeunes-filles-burundaises-une-priorite/>). The camps [trained 102 girls aged 17-25 from all provinces in digital literacy and coding](<https://abpinfo.bi/2025/09/30/la-promotion-des-competences-numeriques-des-jeunes-filles-burundaises-une-priorite/>). UN Women Burundi and Belgium funded them. In the last twelve months, in September 2026, the coordinator of the PAFEN project [said a basic digital skills programme to train 10,000 young people within a year would start soon](<https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7509922575322566656>). No survey share of people with basic digital skills has been found. Operating would need a measured share of adults, or of the population, with basic digital skills, published from a survey.

In October 2025 the government [opened a national call for digital skills training for young people](<https://techafricanews.com/2025/10/20/benin-accelerates-digital-transformation-with-new-oif-d-clic-training-program>). The training is [the OIF's D-CLIC programme, run through the School of Digital Professions](<https://techafricanews.com/2025/10/20/benin-accelerates-digital-transformation-with-new-oif-d-clic-training-program>). In the last twelve months, in November 2026, Benin [became the first pilot country of the SNAEIA network's AI initiative](<https://www.gouv.bj/article/3738/intelligence-artificielle-innovation-benin-designe-premier-pays-pilote-initiative-reseau-consacree-ia/>). Its programme [trains young people in digital tools and skills](<https://www.gouv.bj/article/3738/intelligence-artificielle-innovation-benin-designe-premier-pays-pilote-initiative-reseau-consacree-ia/>). No count of people trained by a programme in service has been found. Establishing would need a government digital-skills programme for the public, in service in more than one location, with a stated number of people trained.

Burkina Faso's digital skills work runs through PACTDIGITAL, a World Bank-financed project. Its [appraisal document of 22 December 2023](<https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/project-detail/P177022>) gives US$22 million to a digital skills component, which [aims to widen access to digital skills programmes](<https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/project-detail/P177022>). In the last twelve months, on 9 November 2026, the ministry's secretary general [announced a free ICT training campaign of about five weeks](<https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article150638>). It [covers office software, AI, cybersecurity, networks and web and mobile development](<https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article150638>). No count of people trained by a national programme has been found. Establishing would need a government digital-skills programme for the public, in service in more than one location, with a stated number of people trained.

[The government's EU-funded digital programme began in August 2024](<https://smartbots.org.bw/projects/eu-digital-transformation>). It [includes digital-skills training for women and young entrepreneurs](<https://smartbots.org.bw/projects/eu-digital-transformation>). [Statistics Botswana's 2024 ICT household survey found 59.2 per cent of individuals had e-skills](<https://www.itu.int/itu-d/meetings/wp-content/uploads/IPS/documents/46/10_EGH2026_DataCollectionBotswana_TebogoTsienyane.pdf>). In the last twelve months, in January 2026, the regulator BOCRA [ran ICT training at four schools](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/3680/bocra-expands-ict-training-to-support-digital-inclusion-in-botswana-schools>). Statistics Botswana [presented the survey to an ITU expert group in 2026](<https://www.itu.int/itu-d/meetings/wp-content/uploads/IPS/documents/46/10_EGH2026_DataCollectionBotswana_TebogoTsienyane.pdf>). No count of people trained by a public programme in more than one location has been found. Establishing would need a government digital-skills programme for the public, in service in more than one location, with a stated number of people trained.

No stage is set. The only fact found is a UNESCO digital-skills project that covers several countries and allocates funds to the Central African Republic. It names no government programme. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Looked for and not found: a government programme to teach the public digital skills, a count of people trained, and a survey of the share of people with basic digital skills. No source from the past three years has been found that says no such programme exists. Preparing would need the government, alone or with partners, to have launched, piloted or be preparing a programme to teach digital skills to the public.

[A youth ministry adviser said in July 2025 that the government's youth programme had given digital skills to 51,601 young people since 2023](<https://digitalmag.ci/journee-mondiale-des-competences-des-jeunes-51601-jeunes-aux-metiers-du-numerique-et-ia-en-cote-divoire/>). In February 2025 the Prime Minister [launched the GENIE project](<https://www.koaci.com/article/2025/02/27/cote-divoire/technologie/cote-divoire-projet-genie-installation-de-35-centres-numeriques-dans-des-colleges-lycees-universites-et-mairies-pour-la-formation-de-plus-de-45000-jeunes-en-competences-digitales_184828.html>). In the last twelve months, the 2026-2030 national plan [sets out digital-training investments of about 95 billion FCFA](<https://www.afriqueeconomie.net/2026/09/pnd-2026-2030-5413-milliards-de-fcfa-dopportunites-dinvestissement-presentees-au-secteur-prive-dans-le-numerique/>). In November 2026 the digital minister [set a target of 200,000 people trained in cybersecurity, networking and AI by 2030](<https://www.linfodrome.com/societe/127288-cybersecurite-abidjan-devient-le-qg-americain-pour-securiser-l-afrique-de-l-ouest>). No location has been found for the 51,601 young people trained. Establishing would need the government programme to be in service in more than one location, with a stated number of people trained.

[In July 2024 the national ICT agency ANTIC launched the sixth Cameroon Digital Skills Campaign in Douala](<https://theguardianpostcameroon.com/post/3519/en/homeat-launch-of-cameroon-digital-skills-campaign-antic-dg-calls-for-investments-in-digital-education-of-youth>). [The three-day event drew over 100 students](<https://theguardianpostcameroon.com/post/3519/en/homeat-launch-of-cameroon-digital-skills-campaign-antic-dg-calls-for-investments-in-digital-education-of-youth>). [In June 2025 the posts and telecommunications minister launched a Digital Citizenship Festival](<https://www.minpostel.gov.cm/index.php/en/actualites/508-national-campaign-to-promote-cybersecurity>) that [aims to train 50,000 young people through regional and national events](<https://www.minpostel.gov.cm/index.php/en/actualites/508-national-campaign-to-promote-cybersecurity>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No count of people trained by a government programme has been found. Establishing would need a government digital-skills programme for the public, in service in more than one location, with a stated number of people trained.

In October 2025 the youth ministry [signed an accord with Cisco and Cybastion to train 250,000 young people in digital skills](<https://acp.cd/nation/rdc-le-programme-national-de-formation-numerique-vecteur-dautonomisation-de-la-jeunesse-congolaise-ministre-de-la-jeunesse/>). [The first train-the-trainer phase, with 500 trainees, ended in Kinshasa in February 2026](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/1802-53044-facing-youth-job-pressures-congo-launches-plan-to-train-250-000-in-digital-skills>). In the last twelve months, on 28 February 2026, the digital economy minister [gave the trainers their certificates](<https://www.zolanews.net/250-000-jeunes-vises-pour-le-programme-national-de-formation-numerique-augustin-kibassa-maliba-remet-les-brevets-aux-formateurs/>). They [are to be deployed nationwide over five years](<https://www.zolanews.net/250-000-jeunes-vises-pour-le-programme-national-de-formation-numerique-augustin-kibassa-maliba-remet-les-brevets-aux-formateurs/>). The 500 counted are trainers, and no count of young people trained has been found. Establishing would need the programme to be in service in more than one location, with a stated number of people trained.

The EU part of the government's digital transformation project [was launched on 17 June 2025](<https://www.eib.org/en/press/all/2025-250-pour-un-avenir-numerique-et-inclusif-au-service-de-la-gouvernance-de-l-economie-et-de-la-jeunesse-l-union-europeenne-renforce-son-engagement-en-faveur-de-l-acceleration-de-la-transformation-numerique-au-congo>). It [aims to develop the digital skills of the population, especially young people and women](<https://www.eib.org/en/press/all/2025-250-pour-un-avenir-numerique-et-inclusif-au-service-de-la-gouvernance-de-l-economie-et-de-la-jeunesse-l-union-europeenne-renforce-son-engagement-en-faveur-de-l-acceleration-de-la-transformation-numerique-au-congo>). The earlier Congo Digital Transformation Project, launched in January 2023, [provides for 3,000 people to acquire certified digital skills from basic to advanced](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/congo-l-aden-s-associe-a-la-societe-anglaise-regalli-pour-deployer-un-portail-numerique-des-services-gouvernementaux>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No count of people trained has been found. Establishing would need a government digital-skills programme for the public, in service in more than one location, with a stated number of people trained.

[In January 2026 the government launched Skodji Digital to train up to 3,000 young people](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/tech/cabo-verde-bets-on-digital-skills-to-tackle-youth-unemployment>). Its first phase [took 1,050 participants](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/tech/cabo-verde-bets-on-digital-skills-to-tackle-youth-unemployment>). In the last twelve months, in April 2026, a [15-station TechLab opened in Brava as a national pilot of the programme](<https://www.digital.cv/blog/brava-como-piloto-nacional-de-inclusao-digital-com-implementacao-do-techlab-no-ambito-do-skodji-digital>). A national digital-skills strategy [is being prepared under the World Bank-funded Digital Cabo Verde project](<https://techafricanews.com/2025/08/08/cape-verde-eyes-gdp-boost-through-stronger-digital-skills/>). No source found says the programme is in service in more than one location with a stated number of people trained. Establishing would need that: a government digital-skills programme for the public in service in more than one location, with a stated number trained.

The World Bank counted [226 people, 79 of them women, given improved digital skills](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099061925050078350/pdf/P174461-c3443395-5530-439e-8048-8c30ea5d880f.pdf>) under the Djibouti Digital Foundations Project by 31 August 2024. The project's coding academy had not started by then. In the last twelve months, the government [launched a feasibility study (statement of 13 May 2026) for Digital Houses in five inland regions under the E-SKILLS programme](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/public-management/djibouti-seeks-to-narrow-digital-divide-with-digital-houses-initiative>). The programme [aims to train at least 3,000 young people and women by 2029 for about EUR 7 million](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/public-management/djibouti-seeks-to-narrow-digital-divide-with-digital-houses-initiative>). No count of people trained by a public programme in service has been found. Establishing would need a government digital-skills programme for the public, in service in more than one location, with a stated number of people trained.

[The national 7-77 digital inclusion programme opened in July 2026](<https://lechiffredaffaires.dz/algerie-telecom-lance-les-premieres-sessions-presentielles-du-programme-national-7-77/>). [By August its 40 online sessions had reached 1,166 people](<https://lechiffredaffaires.dz/algerie-telecom-lance-les-premieres-sessions-presentielles-du-programme-national-7-77/>). [Algérie Télécom began in-person sessions for 600 people at Sétif on 9 August 2026](<https://lechiffredaffaires.dz/algerie-telecom-lance-les-premieres-sessions-presentielles-du-programme-national-7-77/>). In the last twelve months, in April 2026, the vocational training ministry [launched a national 12-week training programme in artificial intelligence](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/5172/algeria-launches-artificial-intelligence-training-programme-to-enhance-digital-skills>). The count of 1,166 is for online sessions and is not tied to more than one location. Establishing would need a government digital-skills programme for the public, in service in more than one location, with a stated number of people trained.

The communications ministry says its Digital Egypt Generations initiatives [trained about 156,000 people in 2025](<https://egyptinnovate.com/en/news/eng-raafat-hendy-277000-trainees-empowered-through-digital-egypt-generations-initiatives>). [They had trained about 277,000 since launch through the end of 2025](<https://egyptinnovate.com/en/news/eng-raafat-hendy-277000-trainees-empowered-through-digital-egypt-generations-initiatives>). In November 2024 the deputy minister [said the ministry's digital literacy initiatives had reached 1,122,837 citizens](<https://www.elwatannews.com/news/details/7692723>). In the last twelve months, in October 2026, Minister Raafat Hindy [said the ministry's digital-skills programmes run in all governorates](<https://www.tafsela.net/98622>). He said [over 2 million citizens benefited over ten years](<https://www.tafsela.net/98622>). No survey share of people with basic digital skills has been found. Operating would need a measured share of adults, or of the population, with basic digital skills, published from a survey.

[The innovation ministry said in July 2025 that its 5-Million Coders programme had certified 900,000 young people](<https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_6969056>). [The education ministry's digital literacy certification has reached nearly 200,000 students and close to 3,000 community members](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2025/06/30/empowering-ethiopians-by-laying-the-digital-foundations-for-afe-economic-growth>). In the last twelve months, for the 5-Million Coders programme, a count in Oromia alone said [956,000 residents had completed it by December 2025](<https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_7899684>). No survey share of people with basic digital skills has been found. Operating would need a measured share of adults, or of the population, with basic digital skills, published from a survey.

[In January 2026 the digital infrastructure agency ANINF and Cybastion launched DigiEmpower, free training for 1,000 young people](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/tech/gabon-launches-digital-skills-program-for-1-000-youths-with-u-s-firm-cybastion>). [Its first cohort of 150 began in Libreville in April 2026](<https://agpgabon.ga/gabon-numerique-ouverture-de-formations-gratuites-pour-150-jeunes-gabonais/>). In October 2024 the digital economy ministry and UNESCO [launched a Global Skills Academy](<https://gabonmediatime.com/gabon-lancement-officiel-de-la-campagne-academie-mondiale-des-competences/>). In the last twelve months, in March 2026, [an agreement is to bring the Smart Africa Digital Academy to Gabon](<https://www.gabonreview.com/le-gabon-sallie-a-smart-africa-pour-former-les-talents-du-numerique/>). In November 2026 [a vocational training centre for web, mobile and IT support skills opened in Nkok](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/tech/gabon-taps-huawei-st-digital-to-build-digital-skills-training-centre>). No count of people trained by a programme in service has been found. Establishing would need a government digital-skills programme for the public, in service in more than one location, with a stated number of people trained.

In July 2024 the ministry [said its Digital Transformation Centre project had trained over 22,000 people since 2020](<https://moc.gov.gh/2024/07/02/communications-and-digitalisation-ministry-trains-22000-people-in-ict/>). [The government aims to train 400,000 people in 2026](<https://gna.org.gh/2026/01/one-million-coders-programme-government-targets-400000-beneficiaries-this-year/>), after a 2025 pilot trained 859. In the last twelve months, between June and August 2026, [the minister reported 5,812 completions across 118 centres](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/one-million-coders-programme-records-141954-registrations-27782-active-learners/>). On 2 November 2026 the minister [said the One Million Coders Programme had registered more than 140,000 people and over 10,000 had completed training](<https://thevaultznews.com/2026/11/02/sensitive-data-must-be-hosted-on-secure-infrastructure-sam-george/>). No survey share of people with basic digital skills has been found. Operating would need a measured share of adults, or of the population, with basic digital skills, published from a survey.

[The universal service agency ANSUTEN launched the third edition of its R-CUN digital training programme on 7 October 2025](<https://mediaguinee.com/2025/10/3e-edition-r-cun-ansuten-insere-plus-de-1-500-beneficiaires-dont-60-de-femmes/>). [Its two earlier editions trained 450 people; the third, for over 1,500, runs 30-day trainings across the country](<https://mediaguinee.com/2025/10/3e-edition-r-cun-ansuten-insere-plus-de-1-500-beneficiaires-dont-60-de-femmes/>). In the last twelve months, on 7 October 2026, [ANSUTEN said R-CUN had trained more than 3,200 people since 2022, about 40 per cent of them women, and launched a fourth edition for over 2,000](<https://horoya.net/2026/10/07/renforcement-des-capacites-a-lusage-du-numerique-lansuten-lance-la-quatrieme-edition-du-programme-r-cun/>). In September 2026 Guinea [approved the feasibility study for a National Digital Academy](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/tech/guinea-advances-plans-for-national-digital-academy>). No survey share of people with basic digital skills has been found. Operating would need a measured share of adults, or of the population, with basic digital skills, published from a survey.

[The communications ministry and Smart Africa agreed in December 2025 to set up a digital academy](<https://techafricanews.com/2025/12/17/the-gambia-partners-with-smart-africa-to-launch-digital-skills-academy/>) for young people and women among others. In the last twelve months, in September 2026, the trade ministry [signed agreements with three training institutions](<https://newglobalmedia.net/motie-signs-mous-to-boost-digital-labour-skills/>) for a three-year WARDIP digital skills programme. It is meant for thousands of Gambians. [The government launched it in November 2026 as a D40 million programme](<https://thepoint.gm/africa/gambia/headlines/govt-launches-d40m-digital-skills-programme-for-1280-youths>) to train 1,280 young Gambians over three years. No count of people trained by the programme has been found. Establishing would need a government digital-skills programme for the public, in service in more than one location, with a stated number of people trained.

[In April 2026 the government and Telecel agreed to launch the STARTOCODE platform](<https://www.odemocratagb.com/?p=56945>). [The government is to train 1,000 young people a year on it](<https://www.odemocratagb.com/?p=56945>). [Fifty women and girls completed a seven-day trainer course on digital skills](<https://ang.gw/impact-hub-bissau-reforca-competencias-digitais-de-50-mulheres-e-raparigas-na-guine-bissau/>). In the last twelve months, in July 2026, the Council of Ministers [approved a draft decree on a National Digital Skills Policy](<https://ang.gw/conselho-de-ministros-aprova-diplomas-sobre-concorrencia-estrategia-para-desenvolvimento-do-caju-e-politica-de-competencias-digitais/>). No count of people trained by a programme in service has been found. Establishing would need a government digital-skills programme for the public, in service in more than one location, with a stated number of people trained.

In mid-2024 the ICT Cabinet Secretary [said the free government digital-skills programme had trained 490,000 young people in a year](<https://www.kenyanews.go.ke/governments-digital-literacy-program-creates-149-000-online-jobs/>). [In May 2025 the government launched a National Digital Literacy Skills Curriculum](<https://www.kictanet.or.ke/kenya-launches-digital-literacy-curriculum-at-connected-africa-summit/>), aiming at 20 million citizens by 2032. In the last twelve months, in September 2026, the State Department of ICT [ran digital-skills training from the Huawei DigiTruck](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/09/11/kenya-trains-330-young-people-in-digital-skills-through-huawei-digitruck/>). In Keiyo South [330 young people completed the course](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/09/11/kenya-trains-330-young-people-in-digital-skills-through-huawei-digitruck/>). In November 2026 the MSME department [launched NYOTA AGPO, a free 10-week online course for over 600,000 young entrepreneurs](<https://www.kbc.co.ke/government-launches-nyota-agpo-digital-training-for-600000-entrepreneurs/>). No survey share of people with basic digital skills has been found. Operating would need a measured share of adults, or of the population, with basic digital skills, published from a survey.

[Orange Digital Center Liberia says it trained 3,035 people in 44 sessions in 2025](<https://thenewsnewspaperonline.com/orange-digital-center-releases-2025-report-exceeds-targeted-impact-goals-across-liberia/>). [It works in all 15 counties](<https://thenewsnewspaperonline.com/orange-digital-center-releases-2025-report-exceeds-targeted-impact-goals-across-liberia/>). In the last twelve months, in September 2026, the regulator LTA and the youth ministry [agreed to set up 15 Youth Digital Skills Hubs](<https://lta.gov.lr/lta-ministry-of-youth-sports-launch-nationwide-digital-skills-initiative-for-liberian-youth/>). The same month the gender ministry [signed with Cybastion and Cisco to train thousands of women in five counties](<https://elbcnews.com/2026/09/23/gender-minister-signs-partnership-with-cybastion-institute-of-technology-and-cisco-system/>). Cyber Liberia 2030 [is to train 20,000 people in digital literacy and cybersecurity from October 2026](<https://development.mfdp.gov.lr/activities/2513>). No survey share of people with basic digital skills has been found. Operating would need a measured share of adults, or of the population, with basic digital skills, published from a survey.

No stage is set. The only fact found is the Libyan Innovation Digital Lab's assessment platform under EU4Skills, an EU-funded skills platform due in 2026. It names no government programme. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Looked for and not found: a government programme to teach the public digital skills, a count of people trained, and a survey of the share of people with basic digital skills. No source from the past three years has been found that says no such programme exists. Preparing would need the government, alone or with partners, to have launched, piloted or be preparing a programme to teach digital skills to the public.

[A 2023 household survey by the regulator and the statistics bureau found 35.1 per cent of individuals had ICT skills](<https://lca.org.ls/wp-content/uploads/filr/4005/COMPARATIVE-HOUSEHOLD-RESULTS-2016_2023.pdf>). [In August 2025 the government and UNDP launched a digital inclusion initiative with 40 community digital ambassadors](<https://www.gov.ls/economy/lesotho-moves-forward-with-digital-inclusion/>). [Community learning centres in Mafeteng had trained 164 people at three schools by September 2025](<https://publiceyenews.com/2025/09/16/tech-initiative-graduates-first-cohort/>). In the last twelve months, in April 2026, the minister [said digital ambassadors work across local councils](<https://www.lena.gov.ls/un-resident-coordinator-pays-coutersy-call-on-information-minister/>). No survey has been found that shows half or more of adults with basic digital skills. Mature would need a measured share of half or more of adults, or of the population, with basic digital skills, to be published.

[The ST Foundation's Digital Unify programme, run with the youth ministry, trained 25,765 people in 45 labs in 2025](<https://www.stfoundation.org/morocco-2/>). [It works in 17 cities](<https://www.stfoundation.org/morocco-2/>). The digital transition ministry says its JobIntech programme [had trained 1,000 people by August 2024](<https://mmsp.gov.ma/sites/default/files/2024-09/BrochureTalentNum%C3%A9rique_24092024_Fra.pdf>). In the last twelve months, in January 2026, the minister [told parliament that two national digital-skills and AI programmes for ages 8 to 18 had begun](<https://fr.alyaoum24.com/numerique-et-innovation/53166.html>). [Youth-centre workshops had reached over 740 children since October 2025](<https://fr.alyaoum24.com/numerique-et-innovation/53166.html>).
